description: `multiverse sweep --dry-run` (cli.py cmd_sweep/_sweep) previews the same UNRECORDED task `sweep-reconcile-records-outcome` actually reconciles: `_reconcile_and_reclaim`'s dry-run branch just filters `found` for TaskState.UNRECORDED (cli.py:2686) rather than calling `tasklog.reconcile`, so `recorded` in the summary line still counts it as a would-be write but the task's own state, and the routing log on disk, are both left exactly as they were. Distinct from `sweep-under-halt-tick-skipped`: this exercises the --dry-run preview path itself, not the halted-fleet `--tick` skip. Exact stdout also pins the host-wide Docker block after the project summary and rejects extra healthy/unknown disk lines. Docker and df are explicit failing fakes, independent of installed host utilities. Plain shell fixtures exercise populated Docker facts without executing Docker; a successful empty probe must print no host lines. The tick preview must follow the host block.
